description: After a delivery PR merges, check on an Expo Simulators iOS session that its OTA update actually landed — wait for the OTA publish run of the merge commit, start a session on the production build with the merge's native fingerprint, make the app check now with appduct's ota_check_now, apply the staged bundle by tapping the update banner with agent-device, and confirm the bundle id and the feature on screen. Always releases the session. Loaded by the ota-verifier subagent. Use when the deliver orchestrator hands over a merged PR, or when someone asks "did the update for
